svg.title: One task hub routes a workflow to specialist workers
svg.desc: Conceptual deployment view, not a network capture. Three independently deployable worker roles connect outward to the same DTS task hub with explicit work item filtering. The orchestration worker registers OrderRouting and requests named activities through DTS. The validation worker registers ValidateOrder and the shipping worker registers ShipOrder. DTS delivers each work item to an eligible registered worker. Recorded outcomes support later orchestration progress. If no eligible shipping worker is available, ShipOrder remains pending rather than falling back to another specialist. Filters do not provide authorization or configure autoscaling.
